code:
192 . 168 . 1 . 10

Each number = 1 octet = 8 bits
4 octets x 8 bits = 32 bits total

192.168.1.0   <- network portion
          .10 <- host portion
(exact split point set by the subnet mask)
caption: An IPv4 address is 32 bits, written as four dotted-decimal octets, split into a network portion and a host portion.
